summary: Per-slot model picker for Flows. Generalises MPI-590's Krea 2 any-of pair to N slots x N members: every slot with more than one candidate gets its own labelled dropdown, shown even when nothing is installed (so the user chooses what downloads instead of falling to slot[0]), with the recommended member marked. Motivated by the scribble flow (MPI-567), whose graph wants an SDXL checkpoint slot and a Klein edit slot picked independently.

Started. Claimed flowsRegistry.js, MpiFlowLibrary.js, MpiDropdown.js/.css, types.js, flow-model-choice.test.cjs and any-of-models.md - the first two taken over from MPI-567's claim by the same session, since MPI-567's FlowDef is a consumer of the slot shape this card lands.
